L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Layered architecture: Transaction Layer + Data Link Layer + Physical Layer.
L16: Point-to-point Link: each Link connects exactly two components via dual-simplex differential pairs.
L16: Per-Lane 2.5 GT/s line rate (Gen 1) with 8b/10b encoding.
L16: Lane widths x1, x2, x4, x8, x12, x16, x32 — symmetric in both directions on a given Link.
L16: TLP framing: STP (K27.7) at start, END (K29.7) at end (or EDB K30.7 for nullified TLP).
L16: DLLP framing: SDP (K28.2) at start, END (K29.7) at end.
L16: TLPs carry a 12-bit Sequence Number + 16-bit LCRC at the Data Link Layer.
L16: DLLPs carry a 16-bit CRC.
L16: ACK / NAK replay protocol guarantees TLP delivery; receiver NAKs on LCRC/Sequence error; transmitter replays from Retry 
L16: Credit-based flow control per Virtual Channel with six credit types (PH / PD / NPH / NPD / CplH / CplD).
L16: Mandatory Virtual Channel VC0 carrying Traffic Class TC0.
L16: PCI 2.3-compatible Configuration Space (256 B) + PCI Express Extended Configuration Space (up to 4096 B per device).
L16: LTSSM bring-up from PERST# through Detect → Polling → Configuration → L0 without firmware intervention.
L16: Configuration Read Type 0 / Type 1 routing per spec rules; Vendor ID = FFFFh indicates 'no device'.
L16: Max_Payload_Size negotiated to the minimum across the path; values 128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096 B.
L16: Switches must forward all TLP types between any set of ports; must not split a TLP into smaller TLPs.
L16: AC coupling on both ends of every differential pair.
